name: Plan Code Runner
description: Executes a JSON implementation plan step by step with the coder agent. On deviation, asks Implementation Plan Reviser to replan only from the affected step onward, then resumes after it if its intended result was achieved or retries it if incomplete.

commands.title: Run implementation plan
commands.description: Runs a saved implementation plan end to end. Input: {"planPath":"absolute path to the plan JSON", "coderAgentName":"saved coder agent (default: coder)", "reviserAgentName":"saved reviser agent (default: Implementation Plan Reviser)", "startStep":1, "maxSteps":40, "maxPlanUpdates":8}. Loads the plan, executes each step through the coder, and passes prior reports as context. On deviation, sends the current plan, affected step, execution outcome, and reports to the reviser, saves a backup and updated plan, then resumes at the next step if the affected step's intended result was achieved or retries the affected step if incomplete. Returns per-step reports, plan revisions, and final status.

commands.title: Preview plan steps
commands.description: Reads a plan JSON file and returns its step list without executing anything. Input must be an object: {"planPath":"absolute path to the plan ."} or a plain path string. Use to check that a plan file exists and is well formed before running it.
